imperium.building.academy.desc: +4 research points per cycle with 2 scholars.
imperium.building.armory.desc: Allows recruiting knights. New recruits get better equipment.
imperium.building.bank.desc: +15% gold income and +1000 storage for all resources.
imperium.building.barracks.desc: Allows recruiting militia and swordsmen. Soldiers are trained here.
imperium.building.factory.desc: 4 workers turn wood and iron into Goods (4 per cycle). Goods make people prosperous (+6 happiness, extra taxes) and sell abroad through trade agreements. Smoke: -3 happiness, and the machines are dangerous.
imperium.building.farm.desc: +8 food per cycle (+3 with Agriculture) with 2 farmers at work, 35% without them. Farmers harvest and replant. Crops in your territory grow faster.
imperium.building.fortress.desc: Province cores of your nation have double HP. Resistance for your people at war, soldiers take less damage at home.
imperium.building.granary.desc: +600 food storage, people eat 10% less. Protects against famine.
imperium.building.hospital.desc: Regeneration in your territory, soldiers heal 3x faster, faster population growth. Doctors work here.
imperium.building.house.desc: Build any house you like: walls, a door and beds. Every bed houses 2 people (max 10).
imperium.building.hut.desc: A small timber house with a porch and a brick chimney. Houses 4 people.
imperium.building.lumber_mill.desc: +10 wood per cycle with 3 woodcutters, 35% without them. Woodcutters fell real trees around the mill and replant saplings.
imperium.building.manor.desc: A three-storey corner tenement with a shop, fire escapes and a water tower on the roof. Houses 10 people.
imperium.building.market.desc: +6 gold per cycle and +4 happiness with 2 merchants, trade agreements bring much more gold.
imperium.building.mine.desc: +8 stone and +2.5 iron per cycle with 3 miners. Miners dig galleries from the shaft, deeper and deeper: ore brings extra iron and gold, but lava, cave-ins and caverns kill.
imperium.building.siege_workshop.desc: Allows recruiting sappers who deal 6x damage to province cores.
imperium.building.smeltery.desc: Furnaces in and around it smelt 3x faster. Steel Furnaces work only here. With 2 smiths turns 2 iron into 1 steel every cycle. Pollution: -4 happiness.
imperium.building.stone_house.desc: A two-storey brick townhouse with a stone base and a cornice. Houses 6 people.
imperium.building.tavern.desc: +6 happiness, -2 food with an innkeeper. More weddings. Where rumours (and volunteers) are born.
imperium.building.temple.desc: +10 happiness with a priest. More weddings. Luck for your people in your territory.
imperium.building.watchtower.desc: Reveals enemy units within 96 blocks. With closed borders soldiers nearby chase intruders twice as far. +2 happiness.
imperium.cb.atrocity.tip: They killed our soldiers who had surrendered.
imperium.cb.border_violation.tip: Their soldiers or people crossed our closed border.
imperium.cb.broken_treaty.tip: They broke an alliance or a pact with us.
imperium.cb.claim.tip: Our spies have "found" old documents proving their land is ours.
imperium.cb.defend_ally.tip: They are at war with our ally.
imperium.cb.guarantee.tip: They attacked a nation whose independence we guarantee.
imperium.cb.reconquest.tip: They hold a province that used to be ours.
imperium.cb.refused_demand.tip: They refused to pay tribute or to give up a province.
imperium.cb.spy_caught.tip: We caught their spies forging claims against us.
imperium.diplo.break_alliance.tip: They will remember it - and get a reason for war.
imperium.diplo.break_nap.tip: Ends the pact (no treachery, but they won't like it).
imperium.diplo.call_to_arms.tip: Ask your ally to join your war.
imperium.diplo.declare_war.tip: With a reason for war (casus belli) your people rally behind you. Without one it is a war of aggression: -15 happiness and the whole world likes you less.
imperium.diplo.demand_province.tip: Demand a border province. A much weaker nation may give in; if not, you get a reason for war.
imperium.diplo.demand_tribute.tip: If they refuse, you get a reason for war.
imperium.diplo.denounce.tip: Everybody who likes you will like them less. They get a reason for war against you.
imperium.diplo.fabricate_claim.tip: Spies forge a claim in 3 minutes: a reason for war. 25% chance they get caught.
imperium.diplo.guarantee.tip: If anyone attacks them, you join the war. They will like you for it.
imperium.diplo.insult.tip: -20 opinion. Gives them a reason for war against you.
imperium.diplo.peace_province.tip: Peace if they give up a border province. They agree when the war score is clearly in your favour.
imperium.diplo.propose_access.tip: Your soldiers may cross each other's closed borders.
imperium.diplo.propose_alliance.tip: Allies defend each other and may cross each other's borders.
imperium.diplo.propose_nap.tip: Attacking a pact partner is treachery.
imperium.diplo.propose_peace.tip: End the war, nobody gains anything. A truce follows.
imperium.diplo.propose_trade.tip: +gold every cycle for both, more with markets. Your goods sell abroad.
imperium.diplo.revoke_access.tip: Their soldiers become intruders on our closed land.
imperium.dlg.bye.1: Mind the mud on your way out.
imperium.dlg.bye.2: Come back when you have bread.
imperium.dlg.family.children.0: We have %6$s children now! The house is loud, the pot is empty and I've never been happier.
imperium.dlg.family.children.1: %6$s little mouths to feed. Lower the taxes, %1$s!
imperium.dlg.family.married_f.0: My husband %3$s snores like a bear, but he's my bear.
imperium.dlg.family.married_f.1: %3$s and I are saving for a bigger house. Someday.
imperium.dlg.family.married_f.2: Since the wedding we eat less and laugh more. Love is cheaper than bread.
imperium.dlg.family.married_m.0: My wife %3$s runs the house and me. Mostly me.
imperium.dlg.family.married_m.1: %3$s and I share everything: the bed, the soup, the debts.
imperium.dlg.family.married_m.2: Married life is good, %1$s. Two eat cheaper than one, believe it or not.
imperium.dlg.family.miner_husband.0: My wife %3$s went down into the mine. Braver than me, that one.
imperium.dlg.family.miner_wife.0: My husband %3$s works in the mine. Every evening I stand at the window until I see his lamp.
imperium.dlg.family.miner_wife.1: They say the new gallery is deep. Too deep. %3$s just laughs.
imperium.dlg.family.mourning.0: %3$s is gone. The bed is cold, the table too big.
imperium.dlg.family.mourning.1: People say time heals. Time just makes the house quieter. %3$s...
imperium.dlg.family.single.0: Family? Me? I'm still looking. The tavern girls laugh at my jokes, that's a start.
imperium.dlg.family.single.1: No wife, no children, no worries. Well, a few worries.
imperium.dlg.family.single.2: My mother keeps asking when I'll marry. I keep asking when the famine ends.
imperium.dlg.family.single_f.0: Family? There's a woodcutter who keeps bringing me firewood. We'll see.
imperium.dlg.family.single_f.1: I'm not in a hurry. Marriage is forever and forever is a long time.
imperium.dlg.family.spouse_trapped.0: %3$s is trapped in the mine! Please, %1$s, send people with shovels!
imperium.dlg.family.spouse_trapped.1: I can't eat, I can't sleep. %3$s is down there behind the rubble.
imperium.dlg.family.trapped.0: If I don't get out... tell my family I was thinking of them.
imperium.dlg.family.widowed.0: I was married once. %3$s. Some days I still set two plates.
imperium.dlg.family.widowed.1: Life goes on. %3$s would want me to find someone. Maybe.
imperium.dlg.gift.abundant.0: Thanks, but I've eaten seven times today. I'll give it to the pig.
imperium.dlg.gift.abundant.1: More food? I'll need a bigger belt.
imperium.dlg.gift.famine.0: Food! Real food! Bless you, %1$s, bless your children and their goats!
imperium.dlg.gift.famine.1: I'll share it with my little ones. They haven't eaten in three days.
imperium.dlg.gift.famine.2: *sobs* I had forgotten what this tastes like.
imperium.dlg.gift.foreign.0: A gift from a foreigner? Maybe your people aren't so bad after all.
imperium.dlg.gift.foreign.1: Thank you, stranger. I'll tell everyone in %2$s about your kindness.
imperium.dlg.gift.mourning.0: Thank you. %3$s used to bring me food like this.
imperium.dlg.gift.mourning.1: You're kind. I haven't eaten since the funeral.
imperium.dlg.gift.normal.0: Oh, thank you! I'll save it for supper.
imperium.dlg.gift.normal.1: How kind! You're nothing like the tax collectors.
imperium.dlg.greet.abundant.0: Ah, %1$s! Have a sausage. Have two! The cellars of %2$s are bursting!
imperium.dlg.greet.abundant.1: Three dinners a day and a nap in between. Life in %2$s is good!
imperium.dlg.greet.abundant.2: I've put on so much weight my horse filed for retirement.
imperium.dlg.greet.enemy.0: Don't hurt me! I'm just a simple peasant!
imperium.dlg.greet.enemy.2: You won't break the spirit of %2$s! ...Please don't break anything else either.
imperium.dlg.greet.famine.0: Please... a crust of bread, %1$s. Anything.
imperium.dlg.greet.famine.1: I boiled my boots yesterday. Today I'm eyeing the laces.
imperium.dlg.greet.famine.2: Forgive me if I faint mid-sentence. The granaries of %2$s are empty.
imperium.dlg.greet.famine.3: We buried three neighbours this week. Hunger doesn't knock before it enters.
imperium.dlg.greet.foreign.0: A traveller from afar! What brings you to %2$s?
imperium.dlg.greet.foreign.1: You talk funny. Not from around here, are you?
imperium.dlg.greet.foreign.2: Welcome to %2$s, stranger. Wipe your boots.
imperium.dlg.greet.happy.0: What a lovely day in %5$s! Even the cows are smiling.
imperium.dlg.greet.happy.2: I'd sing, but my neighbours have suffered enough.
imperium.dlg.greet.homeless.0: Sorry about the smell. I sleep in the pigsty. The pigs complained first.
imperium.dlg.greet.homeless.1: Twelve of us in one hut, %1$s. Somebody's elbow is always in my ear.
imperium.dlg.greet.homeless.2: Build more houses, I beg you. I'm tired of sleeping standing up.
imperium.dlg.greet.hungry.0: Rations are getting smaller every week. Soon they'll be purely theoretical.
imperium.dlg.greet.hungry.1: Hello, %1$s. You wouldn't happen to have a turnip on you?
imperium.dlg.greet.hungry.2: My stomach growls louder than the army drums.
imperium.dlg.greet.mourning.1: You came to talk? Few do, now that %3$s is gone.
imperium.dlg.greet.mourning.2: The house is so quiet without %3$s.
imperium.dlg.greet.normal.2: Another day in %5$s. Same mud, same chickens.
imperium.dlg.greet.trapped.0: HELP! Is someone there? The tunnel collapsed! Get me out!
imperium.dlg.greet.trapped.1: Water... light... anything... how long have I been down here?
imperium.dlg.greet.trapped.2: Dig, %1$s, dig! I can hear you, I'm right behind the rocks!
imperium.dlg.greet.unhappy.0: What do you want? Taxes? Take my last chicken, why don't you.
imperium.dlg.greet.unhappy.1: Long live... hm, whoever is in charge this week.
imperium.dlg.greet.unhappy.2: Don't mind me, I'm just quietly contemplating a revolution.
imperium.dlg.greet.war.0: Keep your voice down, %1$s! Spies of %3$s are everywhere.
imperium.dlg.greet.war.1: Is it true the army of %3$s is marching on %5$s?
imperium.dlg.greet.war.2: My son went to the front. I sharpen my scythe every evening, just in case.
imperium.dlg.how.abundant.0: Splendid! I've eaten so well I can't see my own feet.
imperium.dlg.how.abundant.1: We have so much bread we've started building with it.
imperium.dlg.how.abundant.2: I named my new piglet after the ruler. It's a compliment, I swear.
imperium.dlg.how.enemy.0: How am I? Your people are burning my village! How do you think?!
imperium.dlg.how.enemy.1: I was fine until your army showed up.
imperium.dlg.how.famine.0: How am I? I ate grass this morning. It tasted like regret.
imperium.dlg.how.famine.1: My children ask for bread and I tell them stories about bread.
imperium.dlg.how.famine.2: Old Wojtek died last night. We buried him with his spoon. He would have wanted that.
imperium.dlg.how.famine.3: If the ruler of %2$s doesn't build farms soon, there won't be anyone left to tax.
imperium.dlg.how.foreign.0: Fine, until your countrymen start trouble.
imperium.dlg.how.foreign.1: Life in %2$s is quiet. Let's keep it that way, yes?
imperium.dlg.how.happy.0: Couldn't be better! I got married last week. To the miller's daughter. Or the miller. I was drunk.
imperium.dlg.how.happy.1: Life is good in %2$s. Even the taxes feel almost voluntary.
imperium.dlg.how.happy.2: Happy as a pig in mud, %1$s!
imperium.dlg.how.homeless.0: I sleep under a cart. It's cosy until somebody drives off.
imperium.dlg.how.homeless.1: Do you know how cold it is to sleep in a barrel?
imperium.dlg.how.homeless.2: The ruler should build houses, not monuments to their own ego.
imperium.dlg.how.hungry.1: We're eating the seed grain now. Next year will be... interesting.
imperium.dlg.how.hungry.2: Could be worse. Could be raining. Oh wait, it is.
imperium.dlg.how.mourning.accident.0: The machines. They don't stop for anybody. Not even for %3$s.
imperium.dlg.how.mourning.accident.1: The factory sent a letter and three gold coins. Three. For %3$s.
imperium.dlg.how.mourning.drowned.0: The water took %3$s. I can't look at the river any more.
imperium.dlg.how.mourning.fall.0: %3$s slipped. One step. One stupid step into the dark.
imperium.dlg.how.mourning.killed.0: %3$s was killed. War, they say, as if that explains anything.
imperium.dlg.how.mourning.killed.1: Soldiers came. %3$s stood in the door. That's all I can tell you.
imperium.dlg.how.mourning.lava.0: The mine took %3$s. Lava, they said. Nothing left to bury.
imperium.dlg.how.mourning.lava.1: Every morning %3$s kissed me and went down the shaft. One morning the shaft spat out fire instead.
imperium.dlg.how.mourning.lava.2: I hate that mine. I hate the iron, the gold, all of it. Give me %3$s back.
imperium.dlg.how.mourning.other.0: I lost %3$s. The days are long and grey now.
imperium.dlg.how.mourning.other.1: Please, don't ask. Since %3$s died I just... exist.
imperium.dlg.how.mourning.starvation.0: We shared the last bread. %3$s gave me the bigger half. Every time.
imperium.dlg.how.mourning.trapped.0: Eight minutes, they said. We dug with our hands. %3$s was knocking on the rock... and then the knocking stopped.
imperium.dlg.how.mourning.trapped.1: Behind the rubble, alone, hungry, in the dark. That's how %3$s died. Nobody came in time.
imperium.dlg.how.normal.0: Can't complain. Well, I can, but nobody listens.
imperium.dlg.how.normal.1: Same as yesterday. Hopefully same as tomorrow.
imperium.dlg.how.normal.2: My back hurts, my goat bites, but the harvest was alright.
imperium.dlg.how.normal.3: Fine, thank you. You're the first person to ask in years.
imperium.dlg.how.trapped.0: How am I? I'm under a mountain, %1$s! Dig!
imperium.dlg.how.trapped.1: Hungry. Cold. Scared. Please tell %3$s I'm alive.
imperium.dlg.how.unhappy.0: Taxes, mud and boredom. The holy trinity of %2$s.
imperium.dlg.how.unhappy.1: Some say we should march on the capital with torches. I'm just repeating what some say.
imperium.dlg.how.unhappy.2: Even the priest stopped praying for the ruler. Now he prays for us.
imperium.dlg.how.war.0: I can't sleep. Every night I hear drums from the border with %3$s.
imperium.dlg.how.war.1: They took my horse for the cavalry. I hope he's a general by now.
imperium.dlg.how.war.2: If %3$s comes here, I've got a pitchfork and a very bad temper.
imperium.dlg.how.war.3: My brother died defending the tower. Make it count, %1$s.
imperium.dlg.jobs.accept.any.0: All right, I'll work at the %5$s. Starting tomorrow. Well, today.
imperium.dlg.jobs.accept.doctor.0: I'll heal them. Or at least make them feel better about dying.
imperium.dlg.jobs.accept.farmer.0: Fields, sun and soil under the nails. I'll take it!
imperium.dlg.jobs.accept.farmer.1: A farmer! My grandfather would be proud. He'd also say I hold the hoe wrong.
imperium.dlg.jobs.accept.innkeeper.0: Pouring beer for a living? Is this a dream?
imperium.dlg.jobs.accept.merchant.0: Buy cheap, sell dear, smile always. I was born for this.
imperium.dlg.jobs.accept.miner.0: The mine... alright. Somebody has to go down there.
imperium.dlg.jobs.accept.miner.1: Down into the dark for iron and gold. Pray for me, %1$s.
imperium.dlg.jobs.accept.miner.2: They say the deeper you dig, the richer the ore. And the hotter the lava.
imperium.dlg.jobs.accept.priest.0: I'll serve. Somebody has to pray for all those miners.
imperium.dlg.jobs.accept.scholar.0: Books! Quiet! Nobody shouting! When do I start?
imperium.dlg.jobs.accept.smith.0: Hammer and anvil. My kind of music.
imperium.dlg.jobs.accept.woodcutter.0: Woodcutter? Finally a job where I can hit things.
imperium.dlg.jobs.accept.woodcutter.1: Give me the axe. The trees around here won't know what hit them.
imperium.dlg.jobs.accept.worker.0: The factory? Steady pay and a cough for life. Deal.
imperium.dlg.jobs.accept.worker.1: Machines don't argue. I like that.
imperium.dlg.jobs.ask.0: Work? Now you're talking. What have you got?
imperium.dlg.jobs.ask.1: I'm listening, %1$s. Just not the latrines again.
imperium.dlg.jobs.none.0: All the places are taken. Build something and come back.
imperium.dlg.jobs.quit.0: Fine, I quit. Freedom tastes like... hunger, mostly.
imperium.dlg.jobs.quit.1: No more work? I'll be in the tavern if you need me.
imperium.dlg.jobs.refuse_grumpy.1: Pay me double and we'll talk. No? Then no.
imperium.dlg.jobs.refuse_mourning.0: Not now. Not after %3$s. Give me time.
imperium.dlg.jobs.refuse_mourning.1: I can't even get out of bed. Work can wait. %3$s can't come back.
imperium.dlg.joke.abundant.0: We eat so much in %2$s that our sheep went on a diet out of solidarity.
imperium.dlg.joke.abundant.1: Our bard ate his lute. It was made of gingerbread. Good times.
imperium.dlg.joke.famine.0: Why does everyone in %2$s stand so straight? Nothing in our stomachs to weigh us down.
imperium.dlg.joke.famine.1: My diet is going great. Not by choice.
imperium.dlg.joke.famine.2: What's for dinner? A story about dinner.
imperium.dlg.joke.normal.0: Why didn't the skeleton join the army? It had no guts.
imperium.dlg.joke.normal.1: A villager walks into a smithy. 'Hmm.' Walks out. 'Hmm.'
imperium.dlg.joke.normal.2: My wife said I should dig more. So I dug a hole. Now I live in it. She was right.
imperium.dlg.joke.normal.3: Why don't endermen play cards? Someone always looks them in the eye.
imperium.dlg.joke.normal.4: I asked the librarian for a book about Nether portals. She said it's out of this world.
imperium.dlg.joke.unhappy.0: What's the difference between our ruler and a creeper? The creeper only blows up your house once.
imperium.dlg.joke.unhappy.1: Taxes in %2$s are like rain. Constant, cold, and nobody ordered them.
imperium.dlg.joke.war.0: How many soldiers of %3$s does it take to light a torch? None, they're afraid of the dark.
imperium.dlg.joke.war.1: The army of %3$s is so slow that snails overtake it on the way to battle.
imperium.dlg.joke.war.2: Our general shouted: shields up! So we sold them. Prices were up.
imperium.dlg.news.ally.0: We're allied with %3$s now. Their bread is terrible, but their swords are sharp.
imperium.dlg.news.ally.1: An envoy from %3$s came by. Wore a hat taller than our church.
imperium.dlg.news.borders.0: The borders are closed. Soldiers stop everyone at the border posts. Even the goats need papers now.
imperium.dlg.news.borders.1: Since the borders closed, strangers think twice before coming here. Good.
imperium.dlg.news.building.0: Have you seen our new building, %5$s? Fancy! We'll all be rich now. Probably.
imperium.dlg.news.building.1: They finally finished the %5$s. It took longer than my marriage.
imperium.dlg.news.famine.0: The neighbours are leaving for other lands. Can't blame them.
imperium.dlg.news.famine.1: The rats left too. That's when you know it's bad.
imperium.dlg.news.gossip.birth.0: %3$s and %6$s had a baby! Loud as a war horn already.
An accident at the factory. %3$s. The machine didn't even slow down.
They say the factory is cursed. First a hand, now %3$s.
imperium.dlg.news.gossip.death.drowned.0: %3$s drowned. Stay away from deep water, %1$s.
imperium.dlg.news.gossip.death.fall.0: Did you hear about %3$s? A fall. In the mine, they say.
imperium.dlg.news.gossip.death.killed.0: %3$s is dead. Killed. These are dark times, %1$s.
imperium.dlg.news.gossip.death.lava.0: Did you hear? The mine in %5$s has claimed another life: %3$s. A lava pocket.
imperium.dlg.news.gossip.death.lava.1: They say %3$s broke into a lava pocket. Only a melted pickaxe came back up.
imperium.dlg.news.gossip.death.lava.2: Poor %3$s. Lava. My cousin says he saw the glow from the shaft.
imperium.dlg.news.gossip.death.other.0: Did you hear? %3$s has died. May they rest in peace.
imperium.dlg.news.gossip.death.starvatio: Hunger took %3$s last night. Who's next?
imperium.dlg.news.gossip.death.trapped.0: Have you heard about %3$s? Cave-in. They didn't dig through in time.
imperium.dlg.news.gossip.death.trapped.1: They found %3$s behind the rubble. Starved. In the middle of our country, starved underground.
imperium.dlg.news.gossip.execution.0: They say %6$s killed prisoners. %3$s among them. Monsters.
imperium.dlg.news.gossip.lava.0: %3$s nearly fell into lava down in the mine! Sealed it with cobblestone at the last moment.
imperium.dlg.news.gossip.lava.1: The miners say the deeper galleries are hot. %3$s saw lava with their own eyes.
imperium.dlg.news.gossip.lost.0: %3$s fell into a cavern under %5$s. Nobody knows where. Somebody has to go down and look!
imperium.dlg.news.gossip.marriage.0: %3$s and %6$s got married! The whole street danced till morning.
imperium.dlg.news.gossip.marriage.1: Have you heard? %3$s and %6$s! Who would have thought.
imperium.dlg.news.gossip.marriage.2: The wedding of %3$s and %6$s - three barrels of beer and only one fight. A success!
imperium.dlg.news.gossip.mercy.0: Our ruler let a prisoner, %3$s, go home to %6$s. Some call it weakness, I call it decency.
imperium.dlg.news.gossip.rescued.0: They got %3$s out alive! Thin as a rake, but alive!
imperium.dlg.news.gossip.rescued.1: A miracle in the mine! %3$s is back. The whole street is drinking to it.
imperium.dlg.news.gossip.surrender.0: The army of %3$s surrendered at %5$s! %6$s soldiers threw down their weapons.
imperium.dlg.news.gossip.surrender.1: Prisoners from %3$s are sitting in %5$s with their hands up. Some of them look relieved.
imperium.dlg.news.gossip.trapped.0: Cave-in in the mine at %5$s! %3$s is down there behind the rubble! Everyone's grabbing shovels!
imperium.dlg.news.gossip.trapped.1: They can still hear %3$s knocking. Somebody has to dig them out before the hunger does its work.
imperium.dlg.news.lost.0: We lost a province. Grandma says it's the first time since the Great Pig Plague.
imperium.dlg.news.lost.1: Refugees keep coming from the border. They have nothing left but stories.
imperium.dlg.news.peace.0: Nothing happens here. The last big news was a cow escaping.
imperium.dlg.news.peace.1: Peace with %3$s holds. For now. Peace is just a deep breath before the shouting.
imperium.dlg.news.prosperity.0: New shoes, new pots, new everything! The factories are working, %1$s.
imperium.dlg.news.prosperity.1: For the first time in my life I bought something I didn't need. Is this what they call prosperity?
imperium.dlg.news.rich.0: They say the treasury is full of gold. I've never seen any of it, but it's nice to know.
imperium.dlg.news.rich.1: Merchants from %3$s come to trade with us. We must be doing something right.
imperium.dlg.news.strongest.0: Word is %3$s is the mightiest realm around. Makes you nervous.
imperium.dlg.news.strongest.1: Travellers say %3$s has more soldiers than trees.
imperium.dlg.news.war.0: They say %2$s and %3$s are at war. In the tavern the odds are three to one.
imperium.dlg.news.war.1: Soldiers marched through last night and took all our eggs. For morale, they said.
imperium.dlg.prisoner.flee.0: ...He's running! The prisoner is running home!
imperium.dlg.prisoner.full.0: You can't even feed the soldiers you have, %1$s. Your army is full.
imperium.dlg.prisoner.greet.0: Don't shoot! I surrender! I have a mother!
imperium.dlg.prisoner.greet.1: My weapons are down, see? What happens to me now, %1$s?
imperium.dlg.prisoner.no.0: Never! I'd rather rot here than betray %2$s.
imperium.dlg.prisoner.no.1: You can take my sword, not my honour.
imperium.dlg.prisoner.no.2: Ask me again tomorrow. Maybe I'll be hungrier.
imperium.dlg.prisoner.other.0: I'm a prisoner of %3$s. Talk to them, not to me.
imperium.dlg.prisoner.poor.0: A bribe with empty pockets? Come back when the treasury is full.
imperium.dlg.prisoner.released.0: I can go? Just like that? Thank you. I won't forget it.
imperium.dlg.prisoner.yes.army.0: Better a new flag than a grave. I'm yours, commander.
imperium.dlg.prisoner.yes.army.1: %2$s never paid me anyway. Where do I sign?
imperium.dlg.prisoner.yes.work.0: No more marching? A bed, a job, a roof? You've got yourself a worker.
imperium.dlg.prisoner.yes.work.1: I'm tired of war. I'll work for you, %1$s.
imperium.dlg.recruit.foreign.0: Join YOUR army? I'm loyal to %2$s, thank you very much.
imperium.dlg.recruit.full.0: They say the army is full. Not even room for a drummer.
imperium.dlg.recruit.no.famine.0: I can barely lift a spoon, let alone a sword.
imperium.dlg.recruit.no.happy.0: Why would I go to war? Life is perfect here!
imperium.dlg.recruit.no.happy.1: And leave my garden? The tomatoes would never forgive me.
imperium.dlg.recruit.no.married.0: And leave %3$s alone? Find somebody without a family, %1$s.
imperium.dlg.recruit.no.married.1: I promised %3$s I'd grow old in this house. No uniform for me.
imperium.dlg.recruit.no.normal.0: Me? A soldier? I faint at the sight of jam.
imperium.dlg.recruit.no.normal.1: Sorry, my cow needs me. She's very demanding.
imperium.dlg.recruit.no.war.0: I have six children! Who will feed them if %3$s gets me?
imperium.dlg.recruit.nobarracks.0: Join what army? There aren't even barracks here.
imperium.dlg.recruit.nobarracks.1: Build barracks first, then we'll talk about glory.
imperium.dlg.recruit.yes.famine.0: Do soldiers get fed? Then I'm your man!
imperium.dlg.recruit.yes.famine.1: I'd fight a dragon for a bowl of soup. Sign me up.
imperium.dlg.recruit.yes.happy.0: Why not! Adventure, glory, a free helmet!
imperium.dlg.recruit.yes.normal.0: For %2$s! Where do I get my sword? Is it pointy?
imperium.dlg.recruit.yes.normal.1: Fine, fine. Anything to get away from my mother-in-law.
imperium.dlg.recruit.yes.war.0: %3$s burned my father's farm. Give me a spear.
imperium.dlg.recruit.yes.war.1: I'll defend %5$s with my life! ...Hopefully not with all of it.
imperium.dlg.ruler.hate.0: The ruler? I'd say it to their face, but I like my head where it is.
imperium.dlg.ruler.hate.1: We're starving and they build statues. Statues! Of themselves!
imperium.dlg.ruler.hate.2: There's talk of a new ruler. Maybe a goat. The goat has better ideas.
imperium.dlg.ruler.love.0: Our ruler? A saint! Low taxes, full plates. Long may they reign!
imperium.dlg.ruler.love.1: I hung a portrait of the ruler above my bed. My wife is jealous.
imperium.dlg.ruler.love.2: The best ruler %2$s ever had. Don't tell the previous one.
imperium.dlg.ruler.ok.0: Could be worse. The last one fed the treasury to a dragon.
imperium.dlg.ruler.ok.1: They're alright. Mostly. Sometimes. On Tuesdays.
imperium.dlg.ruler.ok.2: As long as there's bread and no war, I don't care who sits on the throne.
imperium.dlg.soldier.dismiss.0: Free at last! I'm going home to my cabbages.
imperium.dlg.soldier.dismiss.1: An honourable discharge? I'll take it. Farewell, commander!
imperium.dlg.soldier.enemy.1: You'll get nothing from me but cold steel.
imperium.dlg.soldier.follow.2: Following. Try not to walk into lava.
imperium.dlg.soldier.foreign.2: Nice armour. Is it from %3$s? Ours is better.
imperium.dlg.soldier.greet.famine.0: Commander... can we fight on empty stomachs? Asking for the whole regiment.
imperium.dlg.soldier.greet.famine.1: I ate my belt. The leather one. The others are eyeing their boots.
imperium.dlg.soldier.greet.happy.0: Morale is excellent, commander! We even started a choir.
imperium.dlg.soldier.greet.happy.1: Good food, good pay, good weather. Is this a trap?
imperium.dlg.soldier.greet.normal.2: All quiet on our front. Too quiet.
imperium.dlg.soldier.greet.unpaid.0: With respect, commander, when do we get paid? Sharpening isn't free.
imperium.dlg.soldier.greet.unpaid.1: The lads are muttering about deserting. I'm not. Yet.
imperium.dlg.soldier.greet.war.0: Give the word and we'll march on the enemy!
imperium.dlg.soldier.greet.war.1: My blade is sharp and my nerves are... mostly fine.
imperium.dlg.soldier.greet.war.2: For %2$s! Point me at the enemy.
imperium.dlg.soldier.hold.0: I'll hold this position. Nobody passes!
imperium.dlg.soldier.hold.1: Standing guard. Like a very determined tree.
imperium.dlg.soldier.morale.famine.0: Morale? We're boiling our shields for soup, commander.
imperium.dlg.soldier.morale.famine.1: A man can't fight on hope alone. We need bread.
imperium.dlg.soldier.morale.high.0: We'd follow you into the Nether, commander!
imperium.dlg.soldier.morale.high.1: Spirits are high. Somebody even polished the helmets.
imperium.dlg.soldier.morale.low.0: Honestly? The men are tired and scared.
imperium.dlg.soldier.morale.low.1: Half the regiment wants to go home. The other half already left.
imperium.dlg.soldier.morale.ok.0: Morale's fine. Food's fine. The sergeant snores, though.
imperium.dlg.soldier.morale.unpaid.0: No pay for weeks. The men are selling their arrows.
imperium.dlg.soldier.morale.unpaid.1: We fight for %2$s... but %2$s should pay us.
imperium.dlg.soldier.return.0: Back to the barracks. Hope there's soup.
imperium.dlg.subtitle: %s of %s
imperium.dlg.threaten.give.0: Take it! Take everything! Just leave my goat!
imperium.dlg.threaten.give.1: H-here, my savings. Please just go away.
imperium.dlg.work.doctor.0: Bandages, herbs and a lot of praying. Medicine is mostly praying.
imperium.dlg.work.doctor.1: Bring me the wounded, %1$s. Not the dead - I'm good, but not that good.
imperium.dlg.work.farmer.0: Wheat, carrots, potatoes. And one very suspicious pumpkin.
imperium.dlg.work.farmer.1: If you trample my farmland, I will haunt you.
imperium.dlg.work.innkeeper.0: I pour beer and listen. Everything in %2$s happens first in my tavern.
imperium.dlg.work.innkeeper.1: Half of the weddings in this town started at my counter.
imperium.dlg.work.merchant.0: Buy low, sell high, and never trust anyone from %3$s.
imperium.dlg.work.merchant.1: I sell emeralds, carpets and slightly used horses.
imperium.dlg.work.miner.0: I dig. Down. It's not complicated, but it's honest.
imperium.dlg.work.miner.1: Found diamonds once. Then lava found me. Long story.
imperium.dlg.work.peasant.0: No job yet. Give me a pickaxe, a hoe, anything - I'm going mad from sitting around.
imperium.dlg.work.peasant.1: I'm between jobs. Mostly between the bench and the tavern.
imperium.dlg.work.peasant.2: Unemployed, %1$s. If you need hands, I have two.
imperium.dlg.work.priest.0: I pray for the harvest, the army and your soul. Mostly the harvest.
imperium.dlg.work.priest.1: Ring the bell, light the candles, hope for the best.
imperium.dlg.work.scholar.0: I'm researching why the sky is blue. Funding is... limited.
imperium.dlg.work.scholar.1: Knowledge is power. It's also very heavy when it's in books.
imperium.dlg.work.smith.0: Iron goes in, steel comes out, and my eyebrows go missing.
imperium.dlg.work.smith.1: The smeltery makes the best steel in %2$s. And the worst air.
imperium.dlg.work.woodcutter.0: I cut trees. I swear the trees have started to bite back.
imperium.dlg.work.woodcutter.1: Logs for the mill, planks for the houses, splinters for me.
imperium.dlg.work.worker.0: Twelve hours at the machines. My ears ring even in my sleep.
imperium.dlg.work.worker.1: We make goods. What goods? Goods. Don't ask, just buy.
imperium.dlg.work.worker.2: Last week the press took a man's hand. The foreman said: production must go on.
imperium.dlgopt.ruler: What do you think of the ruler?

imperium.help.1: Admin: /imperium arena <size>, /imperium autodivide <nations> <provinces>, /imperium start, /imperium grace <seconds> (or the Editor tab in the strategy view).
imperium.help.2: Players: /imperium join <nation> or press N. G toggles the strategy (RTS) view.
imperium.help.3: Build: in the RTS view pick a building, mark the plot, then build it by hand in first person - the HUD lists the blocks you need. Or buy a ready-made one.
imperium.help.4: Economy: deposit materials in the National Treasury (in your capital tower). Buildings produce resources every cycle.
imperium.help.5: Army: build Barracks, recruit units in the Army tab, select them with the mouse and right click to give orders.
imperium.help.6: War: declare war in Diplomacy, then destroy the core in the enemy province tower to capture the province.
imperium.help.7: Citizens live their lives: give them jobs (talk to them or use the People tab), they marry, mourn and gossip. Miners dig deeper and deeper - and sometimes don't come back.
imperium.help.8: K - technology tree, N - nation & diplomacy, B - show/hide borders.

imperium.tech.agriculture.desc: Farms produce +3 food. Unlocks the Granary.
imperium.tech.archery.desc: Unlocks the Archery Range and archers.
imperium.tech.architecture.desc: +20% housing. Unlocks the Stone House and the Manor.
imperium.tech.diplomacy.desc: Allows proposing alliances and non-aggression pacts.
imperium.tech.espionage.desc: Spies can fabricate claims against other nations - a reason for war.
imperium.tech.fortification.desc: Province cores +50% HP. Unlocks the Fortress.
imperium.tech.gunpowder.desc: Sappers deal double damage to cores.
imperium.tech.industry.desc: +25% wood, stone and iron production, safer mines. Unlocks the Factory.
imperium.tech.mass_production.desc: Factories make 50% more goods from the same materials. +2 citizens.
imperium.tech.metallurgy.desc: Unlocks the Smeltery and steel production.
imperium.tech.siege.desc: Unlocks the Siege Workshop and sappers.
imperium.tech.trade.desc: Unlocks the Market and trade agreements.
imperium.tech.writing.desc: +1 research per cycle. Unlocks the Academy.

imperium.ui.tip.aggression: No reason for war: attacking them would be a war of aggression (-15 happiness, everyone likes you less). Get a reason: closed-border intrusions, insults, refused demands, claims made by spies, lost provinces...
imperium.ui.tip.auto_jobs: New citizens get a job automatically every cycle.
imperium.ui.tip.borders: Closed borders: foreign soldiers and strangers on your land are warned and then attacked and chased by your army - even in peace. Allies and nations with military access may pass. Every intrusion gives you a reason for war.
imperium.ui.tip.citizen_cap: Citizen limit = 4 + time %s + technologies %s + houses %s (at most the population: %s)
imperium.ui.tip.hire_all: Every unemployed citizen gets the most needed job (farms first when food runs out).
imperium.ui.tip.patrol: Patrol [P]: then right-click the route end (Shift: more waypoints). Soldiers walk back and forth and fight intruders.
imperium.ui.tip.tax.high: High taxes: more gold, unhappy people.
imperium.ui.tip.tax.low: Low taxes: less gold, happier people.
imperium.ui.tip.workplace: Workers: %s. Without workers the building gives %s%% of its output.
imperium.ui.treasury_hint: Right click the treasury with logs, stone, iron, gold, steel, food or books to deposit them.

imperium.unit.archer.desc: Shoots from afar, keeps distance from melee attackers.
imperium.unit.knight.desc: Full steel armour and a steel sword. Expensive and terrifying.
imperium.unit.militia.desc: Cheap conscripts with stone swords. Better than nothing.
imperium.unit.sapper.desc: Deals 6x damage to province cores. Escort them!
imperium.unit.swordsman.desc: Iron sword, chainmail and a shield. The backbone of the army.
